what: The background fills from the side the pointer enters — entering the upper half of the element fills from the top, the lower half from the bottom, the background panel scales vertically 0→1 over 1s expo.out and the text color changes (ink → white). On leaving, it folds toward the exit side over the same length and the text color returns

options.dur: Duration of filling and folding (seconds), default 1
options.[data-fx-part=bg]: Rising background panel (required) — color is --fx-fill (default var(--kf-ink))
options.--fx-fill-ink · --fx-rest-ink: Text color when filled · normal (css variables), default var(--kf-on-accent) · var(--kf-ink). If left empty, the text color stays as is

from.where: index.html contact board buttons · FAQ rows (original data-bg-hover — up/down decided by offsetY, scaleY 1s expo.out, text rgb(255)↔#131313)

note: Does not stick on touch devices (the original also turns it off for touchDevice)
